_m2_8_audit: M2.8 (2026-08-04): deps.json completeness gate. Every harvested lib/wasm/lib/*.a runtime artifact in `wasm_built` now carries {license (SPDX id), gpl_compatible, rationale, source}. Build-time-only / native-harness deps recorded under `toolchain` with build_time:true. FINDING: every SHIPPED runtime dep is GPL-compatible under Blender's GPL-2.0-or-later — the two Apache-2.0 deps (oneTBB, OpenImageIO) and the one MPL-2.0 dep (Eigen) are GPL-compatible via the or-later→GPLv3 path / MPL-2.0's GPL-compat clause (same posture as upstream Blender, which is GPL-2.0-or-later precisely to combine with them). No GPL-incompatible runtime dep. Versions/hashes cross-checked against upstream/build_files/build_environment/cmake/versions.cmake at the pin.

python.notes: M2.1/M2.2 (2026-08-03). Vanilla CPython 3.13.13 static libpython3.13.a for wasm32-emscripten, browser target, JS-EH (-fexceptions; SUPPORT_LONGJMP defaults emscripten) per ADR-001 appendix + M2.0b probe (notes/python-emcc605-probe.md) — matches the JS-EH deps stack, zero dep rebuild. ZERO source patches on emcc 6.0.5 (3.13.13 ships in-tree Python/emscripten_trampoline.c; LONG_BIT not hit). Native bootstrap python.exe (macOS case-insensitive FS) via --with-build-python. Harvest is unix-layout / FindPythonLibsUnix-ready: lib/libpython3.13.a (42.2MB, 2850 defined-T syms = probe parity), include/python3.13/ (Python.h + cpython/ + internal/ + pyconfig.h), lib/python3.13/ (unzipped stdlib incl. build-generated _sysconfigdata__emscripten_wasm32-emscripten.py; CPython test suite excluded). Optional modules absent — need deps not yet harvested: _ctypes(libffi) _ssl/_hashlib(openssl) _lzma(xz) _uuid. Built + harvested by scripts/deps/python.sh (idempotent). WITH_PYTHON NOT yet enabled in blender_web.cmake (M2.3, driver-gated).

numpy.rationale: NumPy C-extension + pure-python tree for the embedded CPython 3.13; launch-critical (M7.pre) and the sole blocker on 8 deferred tier-b suites (script_load_addons/modules + 6 sculpt/paint). BSD-3-Clause is GPL-2.0-or-later compatible.
numpy.notes: Static shape (a): 13 production C-ext modules cross-compiled with emcc 6.0.5 (JS-EH, -matomics -mbulk-memory) via numpy's vendored meson + emscripten cross file, allow-noblas + disable-optimization/threading, ZERO source patches (Pyodide also patches nothing since the meson migration). Combined -> lib/wasm/lib/libnumpy.a (dedup shared f2c lapack-lite); pure tree at lib/wasm/lib/python3.13/site-packages/numpy. Import gate GREEN in a standalone libpython embed under node (numpy.array([1,2,3]).sum()==6; harvested-artifact + site-packages auto-import re-verified). Driver follow-up: register the 13 PyInit_* in bpy_interface.cc inittab + link libnumpy.a into blender.js, then flip NUMPY_HARVESTED=1 (scope_m2b). 1 benign wasm sig warning (random_multinomial, LP32) — only affects np.random.multinomial(large n). See notes/deps-numpy.md.

toolchain._note: Build-time / host-tool / native-harness deps. These are NOT compiled into the shipped blender.wasm payload (build_time:true), so GPL-compatibility of the runtime aggregate does not depend on them; recorded for provenance + audit completeness. emdawnwebgpu is the one FUTURE runtime (browser) dep, pending M4.

dawn.rationale: Dawn (native WebGPU impl) + Tint (SPIR-V reader / WGSL writer, same repo) for the M3 native gpu-module harness (GLSL->SPIR-V->Tint->WGSL->wgpuDeviceCreateShaderModule on Dawn/Metal). NOT in the wasm payload — the browser uses the emdawnwebgpu port instead. BSD-3-Clause.

Becomes a shipped RUNTIME dep at M4 (first-pixels); resolves + downloads on first use, exact port pin to be recorded when M4 pins it (see notes/gpu-shader-chain.md §5 open-question 3). Compile-only probe (--use-port=emdawnwebgpu -c) OK per oracle/TOOLCHAIN.
